standard.description: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for pyriproxyfen, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in formulating public health and agricultural larvicides and insecticides.
standard.scope: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for pyriproxyfen, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in formulating public health and agricultural larvicides and insecticides.

certification.description: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of technical-grade pyriproxyfen must strictly comply with statutory registrations and warning declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.
requirements: Mandates that the pyriproxyfen content shall be a minimum of 97.0 percent by mass, determined by High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) or Gas Chromatography (GLC) using internal standard technique.
Restricts moisture content to a maximum of 0.2 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 4 of IS 6940.
Restricts free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) to a maximum of 0.2 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 11.3.2 of IS 6940.
Limits material insoluble in acetone to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 9 of IS 6940.

Technical pyriproxyfen must be securely packed in containers satisfying the general requirements of IS 8190 (Part 1) for solid technical pesticides, or bulk steel drums under IS 2552. Sampling of the technical material shall be carried out as prescribed in IS 10946.

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the material, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net quantity, nominal pyriproxyfen content (percent m/m), and standard cautionary notices worded in accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

Weighs a quantity of a sample equivalent to 90 mg of pyriproxyfen into a 50 ml volumetric flask. Adds 5 ml of Bis(2-ethylhexyl) adipate (internal standard) solution and makes up the volume to the mark with acetone. Shakes well to homogenize.

Injects a 1 µl aliquot of the prepared solution. Resolves the pyriproxyfen peak and internal standard peak (typical chromatogram shows retention times of approximately 3.6 minutes for the DEHA internal standard and 5.1 minutes for pyriproxyfen). Requires repeating injections until the area quotients of two successive chromatograms deviate by no more than 2 percent.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value expressing purity, moisture, acidity, or insolubles must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.
